note: Defaults from the bot's own 2026 backtest (run lit_live, costs in): a simulation input, not real fills and not a forecast. EXAMPLE settings, not real results of any eval.

notes.consistency: MFFU's Builder eval has no best-day rule (confirmed in research/lit/mffu_rules.json); the 50% rule is for payouts. The switch applies it to the eval as a stress test.
notes.min_days: MFFU's help guides say a pass can come in 1 trading day; the plan page table says 2. The simulation uses 2.
notes.dll: Soft daily loss limit: trading is paused for the rest of the session, the account stays open.
notes.plans: ATLAS 25K and BLITZ 25K both run on a Builder 25K account (target $1,500, max loss $1,000, daily loss $600); the prices are the owner's ($43 and $63). Their own odds are not in this file: set them yourself.
